correctness.rationale: Given three injective prescribed arrows of a uniform permutation, their nonclosed directed paths contract, and the expected cycle count is H_{n-3} plus the number of prescribed closed cycles. For each increasing triple the closed-cycle average is 3/(n-2); for each decreasing triple the fixed-point/two-cycle average is 3(n^2-3n+4)/(n(n-1)(n-2)). Subtract H_n, multiply by probability 1/6, sum n-2 positions. Thus Cov(C,U)=(3n-2)/(6n(n-1)) and Cov(C,V)=(10-3n)/(6n(n-1)), local covariances dividing by n-2, for every n>=3. Independent exhaustive rational n=3..7 checked all locations; not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Finite numerical checks are only supplementary and do not establish the general theorem or bibliographic originality.
